what: who meets whom: 2-3 people or bodies as initials (no photos), joined by an edge labelled with the verb
use_when: the story is a meeting, an agreement or a call between named people or bodies
avoid_when: the articles don't say they met or acted together (no relationship is implied); a list of people (who)
rules: "link": the first person or body and whom it met (1-2 more); edge is the verb, word for word as that scene's narration says it (შეხვდა, მოაწერა ხელი);
